en: Color lithographed multi‑view greeting postcard with floral motifs reading "Gruss aus Kronstadt". It depicts two scenes from the city: a neoclassical 'Concerthaus' (concert hall) and an ornate mansion labeled 'Villa Schuller'. People stroll in front of the buildings. Publisher credit appears on the right margin. The reverse side is a blank address layout in Hungarian ("Levelező‑lap", "Czim").
